journey.name: Jade Network Mismatch
journey.description: Connects a Jade emulator restricted to mainnet from a regtest build and checks the Found step's message. Requires `JADE_NETWORK=mainnet ./scripts/jade-emulator start` in `bitkit-docker`, a regtest debug build with the Jade emulator enabled (see the README) and no Jade paired.

actions.action: Launch the Bitkit app and go to the wallet home screen
Open the menu (testTag "HeaderMenu"), tap Settings (testTag "DrawerSettings"), tap "Hardware Wallets" (testTag "HardwareWalletsSettings") and tap "Add Hardware Wallet" (testTag "AddHardwareWallet")
Tap "Continue" (testTag "HardwareWalletIntroContinue") and verify the "Found Device" step (testTag "HardwareWalletFoundScreen") headed "Found Jade" appears within 15 seconds
Tap "Connect" (testTag "HardwareWalletFoundConnect") and verify that within 30 seconds the Found step shows "Your Jade is set up for a different Bitcoin network." (testTag "HwFoundError")
